# OFS-2 "Estimated Ownership of U.S. Treasury Securities" — Foreign and international holdings
# Total estimated foreign holdings, end of period (in billions of dollars).
# The Dec 2013 Treasury Bulletin OFS-2 table reports foreign holdings figures.
# Using values as reported at the end of FY2013 bulletin:
# March 2003 foreign holdings of total estimated U.S. Treasury securities (billions)
foreign_2003 = 1382.0   # OFS-2, foreign & international holdings, March 2003 (~$1.382 trillion)
# March 2012 foreign holdings of total estimated U.S. Treasury securities (billions)
foreign_2012 = 5114.0   # OFS-2, foreign & international holdings, March 2012 (~$5.114 trillion)

# Nominal U.S. GDP (BEA), in billions of dollars
gdp_2003 = 11510.7   # 2003 nominal GDP
gdp_2012 = 16197.0   # 2012 nominal GDP

n = 2012 - 2003  # 9 years

cagr_foreign = (foreign_2012 / foreign_2003) ** (1.0 / n) - 1
cagr_gdp = (gdp_2012 / gdp_2003) ** (1.0 / n) - 1

ratio = cagr_foreign / cagr_gdp
print(round(ratio, 1))
